title: Delta Blues
tagline: Raw, expressive blues rooted in the Mississippi Delta.
summary: Delta blues developed in the Mississippi Delta through solo singing accompanied by guitar, often using slide techniques and flexible rhythms. Its recordings preserve a powerful regional tradition shaped by African American musical life in the early 20th century. The style influenced Chicago blues, rock, and countless later guitarists.

pillars.name: Robert Johnson
pillars.why: Johnson's recordings became among the most influential documents of Delta blues guitar and songwriting.

pillars.name: Charley Patton
pillars.why: Patton is regarded as a foundational Delta blues musician whose forceful performances shaped the regional style.

pillars.name: Son House
pillars.why: House's intense vocal delivery and bottleneck guitar playing became a major influence on later blues artists.
